high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset scene on a terrace overlooking the sea. The sky is painted with warm hues of orange and yellow, with contrails from airplanes crossing the sky, adding a dynamic element to the otherwise tranquil setting. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a golden glow over the water. In the foreground, there is a person sitting on a blue lounge chair, facing away from the camera, seemingly enjoying the view. The person appears relaxed and contemplative, with their head tilted back as if basking in the warmth of the sunset or perhaps looking up at the sky.
